mkt_season_0.75.hypothesis: Variant mkt_season_0.75 lowers the 1X2 log loss (or goal / corner deviance) versus production and does not lower Main ROI; the gain concentrates in sparse-data matches.

rule.q: de-margined (proportional) 1X2 price at the decision moment

mkt_season_0.75.primary_metric: paired 1X2 log loss difference on all matches (prior: goal deviance); secondary: paired Main ROI difference (close)
mkt_season_0.75.minimum_forward_sample: 600 played matches including >= 150 low-data matches (start of 2027/28)
